text:
The PSRR miss (48.1 vs 49 dB) comes from the tail source MT being in triode. The PMOS pair's Vsg of about 1.09 V puts the tail at about 1.69 V, which leaves MT only 0.11 V of Vds. Raising gmid1 lowers Vsg and should pull MT back into saturation. PSRR's large sensitivity to gmid1 (+7.9% for +10%) is consistent with this. A small cut in It also helps.

{"action": "refine", "reason": "PSRR misses by 0.9 dB because the tail MT is in triode (Vsg of the PMOS pair too high). PSRR is very sensitive to gmid1 (+7.9%/10%); raising gmid1 lowers Vsg and restores tail headroom. Widen the gmid1 bound and allow slightly lower It.", "params": {"gmid1": 16.5, "It": 32e-6}, "bounds": {"gmid1": [13.0, 22.0], "It": [16e-6, 40e-6]}}
